Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Implements the new 323×127 listening card with an 87×87 album artwork area.
- Displays album covers in the private development environment with a bounded, duty-aware texture loader.
- Preserves pose-aware nameplate anchoring, Last.fm attribution, stale-state labeling, and Dalamud UI scaling.
